text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We pass by a crepe shop on our way
home.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Crepes...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What would I want a crepe for?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
They're fluffy, they melt in your mouth,
and
they're kinda cute... Food for
weaklings.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: They're too sweet for someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Crepe Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Could I interest you in our Creamy
Double Honey
Chocolate Banana
Crepe? It's our most popular
item!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway! Let's go get some meat!
Meat! Go big
or go home!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's that kebab place in the park on
the way
back! Let's go there!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...That's definitely better than crepes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She obviously wants a crepe... But I also
feel like
it would be immature to call her
out and shatter
her bravado...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?! You're gonna get a crepe?!
choice_data_list: I want to have some, will you join me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I mean...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're a grown-up. Aren't you
embarrassed to
be eating at a place like
this?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. All right, fine.
choice_data_list: I really want to eat it right now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually eat stuff like this, but I'll
have one
too if you want one so bad.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, miss? Can we see a menu?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My friend here reeeally wants a crepe,
and won't
shut up about it... Heheh. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We both order different crepes
according to our
tastes.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmm! It's so good! But way too
sweet! Ugh! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka eats her crepe, looking extremely

satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uhhh... R-right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Kebabs are clearly the best
food for an
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! The meat's waitin' for
us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we go to the kebab stand in the
park...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Two of your plainest kebabs,
please!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You're gonna have ice cream too?
That's a
lotta food.
choice_data_list: And add a Turkish ice cream to that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! I see!
choice_data_list: Packing away a huge meal is pretty cool too, right?
Packing away a huge meal is pretty cool too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
According to that logic, I gotta have
some too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Make that two dondurmas!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. This is a feast fit for a king! Let's
dig in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Able to eat both meat and sweets,
Vodka seems
very pleased.
